entities.name: Vissk
entities.description: Human wizard of Dominaria, a magus of the future with future sight, killed by Ugin's ghostfire.

entities.name: Muggtoth
entities.description: A cyclops who was poisoned and dying when Vissk and Pinaphet found him.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Dragon whose ghostfire burned Vissk and Muggtoth to death.

events.summary: Vissk and Pinaphet find the dying Muggtoth, and Pinaphet gives the poisoned cyclops an antidote.
events.quote: While waiting he and his apprentice encountered Muggtoth who was dying

events.summary: Vissk and Muggtoth are burned to death by Ugin's ghostfire; Vissk had not realized which dragon he faced.
events.quote: he did not realize what dragon he had encountered and was burned to death alongside Muggtoth

relations.note: Ugin's ghostfire burned Vissk to death.
relations.quote: Vissk was a human wizard from Dominaria that was killed by Ugin .
